tokenBannerText: Access token for '{{id}}' — shown ONLY NOW, store it securely:
confirmCloseTokenDesc: This token is shown only once and cannot be retrieved afterward. If you close now without copying it, you'll have to delete this user and create a new one to get a token again.
title: Users
description: Issue per-user access tokens and assign roles or fine-grained permissions.
empty: No users. Add one above — the created access token is shown once.
confirmDeleteDesc: Their token becomes invalid; access is revoked immediately. This cannot be undone.
confirmRevokeDesc: The user is NOT deleted; only the access token becomes invalid (history/audit is kept). This cannot be undone.
roleDefaultsHint: Using the role's default permissions — no per-user override.
overrideActiveHint: Custom permissions will be saved for this user (overrides the role defaults).
overrideClearedHint: The override will be cleared on save — falling back to the role's default permissions.
